cpc_text: El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027 (remaining greater than an 83% chance).
india_implication: Rabi 2026-27 sowing under El Niño conditions (risk: warm Feb-Mar, weak western disturbances); Kharif 2027 monsoon onset / June-July rainfall at elevated deficit risk if El Niño persists into MJJ (61%).
p_by_season_note: El Nino probability = mean of the IRI plume probabilities over NDJ/DJF/JFM (rabi) or MJJ (kharif); neutral / La Nina split from the plume where stated, else the non-El-Nino remainder split 0.85 : 0.15. Source: iri_plume_2026-09-21.
